newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak Telecom signs deal with U.S. partners.
newsitem.headline: Slovak Telecom signs deal with U.S. partners.

text.p: Slovenske Telekomunikacie s.p., the state-owned telecommunications monopoly, said Friday it had signed an agreement with U S West Media Group Inc. and Bell Atlantic Corp. to form a joint telecommunications venture in Slokavia.

Under the agreement, the three will create a joint stock company, Eurotel Bratislava a.s., in which Slovenske Telekomunikacie will hold a 60 percent stake and the two American companies will share the remaining 40 percent.
The conclusion of the protracted negotiations came just 11 days before a final deadline for talks as set by the Slovak Ministry of Telecommunications.

Negotiations had dragged on since July, when the three partners agreed to create a new company, but had to reach a final framework for the venture conforming to the government's 60 percent Slovak ownership condition.
The talks concentrated mainly on executive rights in the new company and the split of investments.
